name: hands_on_head
text: A standing person raises both hands onto the top of the head in dismay. Both palms press against the crown of the head, elbows wide to the sides. Lean forward slightly and keep both hands on the head until the end.

review.notes_zh: 双手抬至额头两侧上方、肘部外张并保持；末端约束修正首版末尾放手。属于抱头慌张姿态，未保证皮肤层面的掌头贴合。
